item.description:
TypeVoice 1.0.1 — 20 September 2026

  • Everything about how the text reads now lives under Style: numbers as digits, paragraphs from pauses, spoken commands, filler and stutter cleanup, and Smart cleanup with its Apple Intelligence status. Settings keeps the trigger, microphone, indicator and updates.
  • Settings has an About section: the version, Check for Updates, the automatic-check switch and "What's new". Check for Updates is also in the app menu and the menu bar menu.
  • Links from the app open the site's clean addresses.
